label: class_f_01_dragon_01
text: Greetings, I am Hassel. I will be teaching this art\nclass. It is a pleasure to meet you all![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_02
text: Now, let me be candid for one moment.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_03
text: I imagine that many of you will forget all that\nyou learned in this class once you graduate![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_04
text: After all, you don’t need even a basic\nunderstanding of artwork, much less a refined\r\nappreciation of beauty, for most exams or jobs.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_05
text: So, is my class a waste of time for you, then?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_06
text: I think not! At least, I certainly hope it isn’t![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_07
text: Think for a moment, all of you. What is beauty,\nanyway? What makes something beautiful?[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_select_01
text: Its shape and color

label: class_f_01_select_02
text: The eye of the beholder

label: class_f_01_select_03
text: I don’t know

label: class_f_01_dragon_answer_01
text: Interesting... Thank you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_08
text: Oh, I don’t mean to suggest there’s a correct\nanswer to my query. The important thing is that\r\nyou all take time to think about it.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_09
text: Think about why we might find beauty in a flower\nblooming on the side of the road, for example.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_10
text:
Question why the sky is a different shade of blue
than the ocean or why the leaves change color.\c
Ponder the windmills of Artazon and how they
move. Contemplate the chilling bite of the
waters of Cascarrafa.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_11
text: I’m sure you will find that every little detail of\nyour lives will seem more vivid, more impactful,\r\nif you just take a moment to stop and think.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_12
text: And I am certain that if you stop and truly\nappreciate the little beauties of this world...[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_13
text: it will help pull you through the days where your\nstudies have you exhausted or when work has\r\ndampened your spirits.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_14
text: Ah, do pardon me for waxing philosophical.\nYou don’t need to understand all of that now.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_15
text: To put it simply, it is true that one doesn’t need\nart to survive... But it certainly makes surviving\r\nmuch more enjoyable![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_16
text: It is my hope that this class will add even a little\nbit of color to your lives.[VAR 0x0114(0012)]

label: class_f_01_dragon_17
text: That’s all for today—next time, we’ll try a more\nhands-on approach to appreciating beauty![VAR 0x0114(0012)]
